entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • MissingUsings fixer not working with MSBuildWorkspace #80056
  • MSBuildWorkspace might not honor .editorconfig properly #80055
  • EnforceCodeStyleInBuild not working reliably between machines although same .NET SDK #80054
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Update debugger packages, move to PortableInterop IMetadataImport #80063
    Area-Interactive, Community
  • Move the initialization of the global notification service #80062
    Area-IDE
  • Switch to using IVsAsyncSolutionEventListener for batch scope creation #80061
    Area-IDE
  • Remove the 'force compute' entrypoint for diagnostics #80060
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode
  • Only return project diags from project diagnostics request. #80059
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • [Backport] Always run 'required' generators: #80058
    VSCode
  • Automatically attach the Roslyn ServiceHub service to the VS debugger. #80053
    Area-IDE

Merged

  • Enable prerelease for the insertion tests #80057
  • Cache diagnostic analyzer computation #80045
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode, Next
  • [release/dev18.0] Don't cache known-broken compositions #80023
  • Improve Reverse break doc #80043
    Area-Compilers, Documentation, Feature - First-class Span Types, needs-breaking-change-doc-created, Next

Updated

  • Store client's version for open docs in LSP #80064
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Use apphost for core compiler #80026
    Area-Compilers
  • Always run the razor generator even in balanced mode #79510
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Remove flag controlling if non-local diagnostics should be returned when getting diagnostics for a document. #80044
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • 'Cache diagnostic analyzer computation' and 'Disable oop processing for some diagnostics calls' and 'Cache project analyzers ' #80051
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode
  • 'Cache diagnostic analyzer computation' and 'Disable oop processing for some diagnostics calls' #80049
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode
  • Extensions: propagate attributes on type parameters #80032
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Cache project analyzers #80050
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode
  • Crossgen servicehub with non local generics #79976
    Area-IDE
  • Reduce allocations from calling ITypeSymbol.AllInterfaces #79817
    Area-Compilers
  • Disable oop processing for some diagnostics calls #80048
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Reduce allocations in AssemblySymbol.GetTopLevelTypeByMetadataName #79810
    Area-Compilers
  • Ensure that refkinds are rewritten for complex methods #79916
    Area-Compilers
